description_en: Global Accelerator (GA) is a network acceleration service with global coverage. It leverages high-quality Border Gateway Protocol (BGP) bandwidth and the global transmission network of Alibaba Cloud to enable nearby access to global networks, reducing the impact of network issues such as latency, jitter, and packet loss on service quality. GA provides active and high-performance network acceleration for global users. You can call the CreateAccelerator operation to create a Global Accelerator instance
description_zh: 全球加速 GA（Global Accelerator）是一款覆盖全球的网络加速服务，依托阿里云优质BGP带宽和全球传输网络，实现全球网络就近接入，可以减少延迟、抖动、丢包等网络问题对服务质量的影响，为全球用户提供高可用和高性能的网络加速服务，您可以通过调用CreateAccelerator接口创建一个全球加速实例
kebab_example: aliyun ga create-accelerator --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --client-token 123e45670000 --name test --duration 1 --pricing-cycle Month --spec 1 --auto-pay false --auto-use-coupon false --auto-renew false --auto-renew-duration 1 --promotion-option-no 500032980140000 --bandwidth-billing-type BandwidthPackage --ip-set-config AccessMode=UserDefine --resource-group-id rg-aekzrnd67gq0000 --tag Value=tag-value Key=tag-key --instance-charge-type PREPAY --dry-run false --bandwidth 200 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateAccelerator

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the Global Accelerator instance. Set the value to cn-hangzhou
parameters.help_zh: 全球加速实例所属的地域ID，仅取值：cn-hangzhou
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The client token can contain only ASCII characters.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the RequestId of the API request as the ClientToken. The RequestId may be different for each API request
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId不一样
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
The name of the Global Accelerator instance.

The name must be 1 to 128 characters in length and must start with a letter or a Chinese character. It can contain digits, underscores (_), and hyphens (-)
parameters.help_zh:
全球加速实例的名称。

名称长度为1~128个字符，以大小写字母或中文开头，可包含数字、下划线（_）或短划线（-）
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en:
The subscription duration.

If PricingCycle is set to Month, the valid values for Duration are 1 to 9.

If PricingCycle is set to Year, the valid values for Duration are 1 to 3.
This parameter is required only when InstanceChargeType (the billing method of the Global Accelerator instance) is set to PREPAY (upfront)
parameters.help_zh:
购买时长。

当PricingCycle取值Month时，Duration取值范围为1~9。

当PricingCycle取值Year时，Duration取值范围为1~3。
InstanceChargeType（全球加速实例计费方式）为PREPAY（预付费）时，该项必须配置
parameters.name: duration

parameters.help_en:
The billing cycle. Valid values:

Month: billed on a monthly basis.
Year: billed on a yearly basis.
This parameter is required only when InstanceChargeType (the billing method of the Global Accelerator instance) is set to PREPAY (upfront)
parameters.help_zh:
计费周期。取值：

Month：按月计费。
Year：按年计费。
InstanceChargeType（全球加速实例计费方式）为PREPAY（预付费）时，该项必须配置
parameters.name: pricing_cycle

parameters.help_en:
The specification of the Global Accelerator instance. Valid values:

1: Small I.
2: Small II.
3: Small III.
5: Medium I.
8: Medium II.
10: Medium III.
20: Large I.
30: Large II.
40: Large III.
50: Large IV.
60: Large V.
70: Large VI.
80: Large VII.
90: Large VIII.
100: Super Large I.
200: Super Large II.

Large III and higher specifications are available only to users in the whitelist. To use these specifications, contact your account manager.
This parameter is required only when InstanceChargeType (the billing method of the Global Accelerator instance) is set to PREPAY (upfront).

Different instance specifications have different definitions. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153127.html
parameters.help_zh:
全球加速实例的规格，取值：

1：小型Ⅰ。
2：小型Ⅱ。
3：小型Ⅲ。
5：中型Ⅰ。
8：中型Ⅱ。
10：中型Ⅲ。
20：大型Ⅰ。
30：大型Ⅱ。
40：大型Ⅲ。
50：大型IV。
60：大型V。
70：大型VI。
80：大型VII。
90：大型VIII。
100：超大型Ⅰ。
200：超大型Ⅱ。

目前，大型Ⅲ及以上规格仅白名单开放。如需使用，请联系阿里云客户经理。
InstanceChargeType（全球加速实例计费方式）为PREPAY（预付费）时，该项必须配置。

实例规格不同，定义也不同。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153127.html
parameters.name: spec

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable automatic payment. Valid values:

false (default): disables automatic payment. After an order is generated, go to the Order Center to complete the payment.

true: enables automatic payment. The order is automatically paid
parameters.help_zh:
是否自动付费，取值：

false（默认值）：不开启自动付费，生成订单后需要到订单中心完成支付。

true：开启自动付费，自动支付订单
parameters.name: auto_pay

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to use coupons for automatic payment of bills. Valid values:

true: uses coupons.
false (default): does not use coupons.

This parameter takes effect only when AutoPay is set to true
parameters.help_zh:
是否使用优惠券自动支付账单。取值：

true：使用。
false（默认值）：不使用。

仅AutoPay为true时，该项才生效
parameters.name: auto_use_coupon

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable auto-renewal. Valid values:

true: enables auto-renewal.

false (default): disables auto-renewal
parameters.help_zh:
是否开启自动续费。取值：

true：是。

false（默认值）：否
parameters.name: auto_renew

parameters.help_en:
The auto-renewal duration. Unit: months.

Valid values: 1 to 12. Default value: 1.

This parameter takes effect only when AutoRenew is set to true
parameters.help_zh:
自动续费时长。单位：月。

取值范围：1~12。默认值：1。

仅AutoRenew为true时，该项才生效
parameters.name: auto_renew_duration

parameters.help_en:
The coupon number.

This parameter is available only on the China site (aliyun.com)
parameters.help_zh:
优惠券号码。

仅国际站涉及该参数
parameters.name: promotion_option_no

parameters.help_en:
The bandwidth billing method.

BandwidthPackage: billed by bandwidth plan.
CDT: billed by traffic
parameters.help_zh:
带宽计费方式。

BandwidthPackage：按带宽包计费。
CDT：按流量计费
parameters.name: bandwidth_billing_type

fields.help_en:
The access mode of the acceleration area. Valid values:

UserDefine: custom nearby access mode. You can select acceleration areas and regions based on your business requirements. Global Accelerator provides an independent EIP for each acceleration region.
Anycast: automatic nearby access mode. You do not need to configure acceleration areas. Global Accelerator provides an Anycast EIP across multiple regions worldwide. Users can access the Alibaba Cloud acceleration network from the nearest access point by using the Anycast EIP
fields.help_zh:
加速区域接入模式。取值：

UserDefine：自定义就近接入模式。您可以根据业务需要，定向选择加速区域和地域，全球加速为每个加速地域提供独立的EIP。
Anycast：采用自动就近接入模式。您无需配置加速区域。全球加速在全球多地域提供一个Anycast EIP，用户可通过Anycast EIP从就近接入点进入阿里云加速网络
fields.name: access_mode

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group to which the standard Global Accelerator instance belongs
parameters.help_zh: 标准型全球加速实例所属资源组ID
parameters.name: resource_group_id

fields.help_en:
The tag key of the Global Accelerator instance. If you specify this parameter, the value cannot be an empty string.

The tag key can be up to 64 characters in length and cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:`. It cannot contain `http://` or `https://`.

You can specify up to 20 tag keys
fields.help_zh:
全球加速实例的标签键。一旦输入该值，则不允许为空字符串。

最多支持64个字符，不能以`aliyun`和`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或者`https://`。

最多支持输入20个标签键
fields.name: key

fields.help_en:
The tag value of the Global Accelerator instance. If you specify this parameter, the value can be an empty string.

The tag value can be up to 128 characters in length and cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:`. It cannot contain `http://` or `https://`.

You can specify up to 20 tag values
fields.help_zh:
全球加速实例的标签值。一旦输入该值，可以为空字符串。

最多支持128个字符，不能以`aliyun`和`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或者`https://`。

最多支持输入20个标签值
fields.name: value

parameters.help_en: The tags of the Global Accelerator instance
parameters.name: tag

parameters.help_en:
The billing method of the Global Accelerator instance.
PREPAY (default): upfront.
POSTPAY: pay-as-you-go
parameters.help_zh:
全球加速实例付费类型。
PREPAY（默认值）：预付费。
POSTPAY： 后付费
parameters.name: instance_charge_type

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform a dry run. Valid values:
true: performs a dry run. The system checks the required parameters, request syntax, and business limitations without creating the resource. If the check fails, the corresponding error is returned. If the check succeeds, the `DryRunOperation` error code is returned.
false (default): performs a dry run and sends the request. If the check succeeds, an HTTP 2xx status code is returned and the operation is performed
parameters.help_zh:
是否只预检此次请求，取值：
true：发送检查请求，不会创建资源。检查项包括是否填写了必需参数、请求格式、业务限制。如果检查不通过，则返回对应错误。如果检查通过，则返回错误码`DryRunOperation`。
false（默认值）：发送正常请求，通过检查后返回HTTP 2xx状态码并直接进行操作
parameters.name: dry_run

parameters.help_en:
The bandwidth of the standard Global Accelerator instance. Unit: Mbps.

Valid values: 200 to 5000.
This parameter is valid and required only when the access mode of the acceleration area is set to Anycast
parameters.help_zh:
标准型全球加速实例带宽。单位：Mbps。

取值范围：200~5000。
仅加速区域接入模式为Anycast时有效，且必填
parameters.name: bandwidth
